# Nuva Lab

> Nuva Lab collaborates with FastVideo on production grounding and workload evaluation for FastH3.

## Core page

- [FastH3](https://nuvalab.ai/fasth3/): MiniMax H3 post-trained and optimized by FastVideo using few-step distillation, sparse attention, and production inference work.

## Attribution and licensing

FastVideo is an independent Apache-2.0 open-source project. FastH3 uses MiniMax H3 weights and derivatives governed by the MiniMax H3 Community License, not Apache 2.0. Nuva Lab contributes production grounding and workload evaluation; FastVideo owns and maintains its framework and FastH3 artifacts.
